verdict.rationale: Clerk exposes a full Backend API (openapi.json) covering organizations, roles/permissions, sessions, webhooks, SSO, MFA, and OAuth scoped access — mirroring most UI-configurable features — plus a CLI and MCP server for programmatic/agent access. However, no evidence explicitly confirms full UI/API parity (e.g., billing plan management, bot detection config, or passkey settings via API), and community feedback (clerk-comm-3) even notes RBAC limitations suggesting some UI-modeled concepts aren't fully API-native. Missing for 10: explicit parity documentation or independent verification that every UI action (billing, org switching UI settings, admin dashboard config) has a corresponding API/CLI equivalent.
